/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Excalibur/Excalibu.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the fifth anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Excalibur/Excalibu.acquisition:
The Excalibur Dex Skin was available for logging in to Warframe from March 14, 2018 to March 28, 2018. Then, from March 27, 2019 to April 10, 2019 and March 13, 2020 to March 16, 2020, players were able to obtain this skin by completing Anniversary alerts.

In subsequent years, the skin has been available as a reward from Anniversary alerts.
